rows.grounds: dative plural of abhakta, those lacking devotion
optative expressing prohibition or injunction not to reveal

items.question: To whom must this supreme teaching remain concealed despite close familial relationships?
premises: The teaching must not be revealed to non-devotees.
Even sons are included among those excluded.
The injunction explicitly forbids showing it to them.
items.inference: This supreme teaching must remain secret from non-devotees and even from one's own sons.
items.plain_english: But, O Lord of Gods, one should not show it to non-devotees, nor even to sons.
